title: Paloma and the Summit
author: Ulyana Halloran
blurb: Kestrel Whitlock, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, has spent seven years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
